description: d25: fires when a PR head SHA's checks settle with GitGuardian's suite concluded failure (gitguardian in failed_apps) and posts one comment listing each finding (secret type, file and line, commit, incident link, status), never a secret value, with the remediation. Never fixes anything: pr-fixer-checks stays off that head and the pr-fix hold stops every other fix run. pr-fixer-secrets-late reports a failure that completes after the settle. Same-repo PRs of repos in vars.fixer_repos and not in vars.fixer_excluded_repos, drafts included, only while the PR is open. Commented once per head SHA by the action's once_key (durable, shared with pr-fixer-secrets-late), outside the fixer's per-PR key and budget.
name: PR fixer: GitGuardian findings

on_failure.name: Say the findings could not be read

params.body:
GitGuardian fails on {{ trigger.data.head_sha }}, but its findings could not be read ({{ run.error.code }}): open the GitGuardian check on this PR. Revoke and rotate each leaked secret, then remove it from the code; rewriting history does not un-leak it. The PR fixer does not touch secrets and stays off this PR until GitGuardian passes.

Run: https://rules.culture.dev/api/runs/{{ run.id }}
